name: SearchMetadata
description: Run an operator supplied Lucene style query against the PolySwarm metadata index, the same endpoint and query language the PolySwarm intel feed connector drives on a schedule, exposed here directly so a playbook can ask any query instead of the fixed family, tag and polyscore filters the connector applies. This action only reads the index and spends no scanning quota.

query.description: Lucene style query against the PolySwarm metadata search endpoint, for example 'scan.latest_scan.polyscore:>=0.9 AND tags:"ransomware"'. This action only reads the index and spends no scanning quota.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching artifacts to return, from 1 up to a hard ceiling of 200 so a broad query cannot run away. Defaults to 20.

include.description: Fields to include in each returned document, wildcard suffixes accepted (for example 'scan.*'). Passed straight through to the PolySwarm metadata endpoint. Leave empty to let the endpoint decide what a document carries.

exclude.description: Fields to exclude from each returned document, wildcard suffixes accepted. Passed straight through to the PolySwarm metadata endpoint.

found.description: Whether the query matched at least one artifact

results.description: Matching artifacts, up to limit. Empty when nothing matched.

sha1.description: SHA1 hash of the artifact, when the document carries one

md5.description: MD5 hash of the artifact, when the document carries one

malicious_detections.description: Number of engines that returned a malicious verdict

benign_detections.description: Number of engines that returned a benign verdict

total_detections.description: Total number of engines that returned a verdict

polyscore.description: PolySwarm threat score (0.0 - 1.0), when the document carries one

permalink.description: Link to the PolySwarm scan result

family.description: Malware family name, when the metadata carries one

families.description: Every malware family PolySwarm associates with the artifact. Empty when PolySwarm carries no family.

tags.description: Tags PolySwarm associates with the artifact. Empty when there are none.

first_seen.description: First seen timestamp, when the document carries one

last_scanned.description: Last scanned timestamp, when the document carries one

mimetype.description: MIME type of the artifact, when the document carries one

filenames.description: Filenames PolySwarm has seen for the artifact

returned_count.description: Number of artifacts actually returned in results

limit.description: The limit this call ran with

truncated.description: True when more artifacts matched the query than limit allowed to be returned. A truncated answer is not a complete one: raise limit or narrow the query to see the rest.

outputs.found: The query matched at least one artifact, and every match was returned
outputs.not found: The query matched no artifacts in PolySwarm
outputs.truncated: The query matched more artifacts than limit allowed to be returned, so this answer is incomplete
